wholePhysicalScope: The named 19-vertex bell tower way matches Wikidata Q10748461. The adjacent mapped religious site and worship buildings establish the neighboring exterior envelope. The provincial and national tourism records establish the 37 m bell tower height, superseding the lower map tag.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the seven levels, temple halls, flanking shrines and upturned tile roofs. Near levels add the open bell and glazed ceramic bands.
limitations: The model includes the standing temple’s exterior volumes. Some courtyard, roof and window proportions and the exact massing of the adjacent ranges are approximate.
Ceramic materials, colors and trim are independently patterned. Distinctive figurative artwork, the bottle dragon sculpture, statuary, religious inscriptions and interiors are outside the model.
